conditions: 6 AM—Don't spend your day doom-scrolling the latest TikToks; come celebrate with the sun as we cross the vernal equinox. The first official day of spring 2026 will feature deep blue skies and laser-like sun-sations, sending your daydreaming mind to fantastical destinations. Slather on the sunscreen and lose another layer, because temperature records may fall today. Expect highs at the summit that push into the mid-40s as Teton Village once again flirts with the 70-degree mark. A welcome west wind will be breezing through in the neighborhood of 5 to 20 mph. Situated halfway between summer's sweltering heat and the brisk snap of winter, we get to enjoy a taste of both in this magical place. Just feel the rising heat on your cheeks and blast some icy crystals in your face. -Lege
